title: Invisible, Unreadable, and Inaudible Cookie Notices: An Evaluation of Cookie Notices for Users with Visual Impairments
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the accessibility and privacy compliance of cookie notices for visually impaired users. While these topics have ethical implications (e.g., right to privacy, right to accessibility), the paper does not engage in benchmarking or evaluating specific ethical frameworks, moral reasoning, or religious/faith aspects as its primary subject matter. It evaluates adherence to regulations like GDPR and WCAG.
